title.narrative: Halting the spread of HIV and reducing TB Prevalence and Mortality in Eswatini - Eswatini (01-Oct-2024-30-Sep-2027)

description.narrative: Eswatini, TB/HIV, National Emergency Response Council on HIV and AIDS (NERCHA)This program has the following goals: Universal access to HIV prevention, care and treatment for all Eswatini. Reduced new HIV, TB and STIs by 90%. Reduced AIDS-related deaths by 90%. Eliminated mother to child transmission of HIV, Syphilis and Hepatitis B. Zero HIV-related stigma and discrimination. Reduce TB incidence of all forms of TB by 25% in 2028 from 374/100,000 in 2021 to 260/100,000 population. Reduce TB mortality by 20% in 2028 from 85/100,000 to 68/100,000 population. Eliminate patients' catastrophic cost by 2028. The objectives of this program are: To prevent new HIV, TB, viral hepatitis and STIs. To improve the health outcomes of people living with HIV (PLHIV). To reduce HIV-related disparities and health inequalities. To foster collaboration and synergy among all partners and stakeholders to effectively combat the HIV epidemic. To increase TB treatment coverage by 90% by 2028. To strengthen primary and secondary TB prevention services. To achieve 90% treatment success rate for all forms of TB including DS-TB and DR-TB through provision of integrated quality of care. To improve TB screeing, diagnosis, treatment and prevention among children and adolescents. To improve the quality and utilization of TB information for decision making and programmatic actions. To strengthen coordination, governance and human resources capacity for optiomal program performance
